reviews.text: I take my pet there for regular vaccinations, and they always treat my pet with great care and give a gentle and thorough health check.

Both veterinarians were easy to talk to, and we often found ourselves chatting away. They never recommended excessive medical treatment, and their heartworm medication was reasonably priced. I was worried about whether to let my elderly dog, who was having repeated seizures, be left to his own devices or to proactively investigate the cause, and I am deeply grateful that they listened carefully to my concerns and respected my desire to let him die naturally.
The doctors are always thinking about what is natural and comfortable for dogs, and do not prioritize the interests of owners or humans. I trust them deeply.
He is a caring teacher who is considerate of the feelings of pets and their owners.

I got my 2.5-month-old black Shiba Inu vaccinated. 🐶🐕️🐶
I thought he'd be nervous because it was his first time seeing a doctor and visiting a hospital, but the temperature check and vaccination were over in no time. 🐕️🐶🐕️
The doctor looked the dog in the eye, spoke to him, and examined him quickly like a magician. 🐕️🐶🐕️
He also patiently answered all my questions and concerns. 🐶
This is a trustworthy doctor and clinic. 😀
He is a very caring teacher and will explain things to you. I highly recommend him!
